title: Implement bounded experimental reassembly
description:
Implement only the human-approved experimental decoder/reassembly scope on its selected backend. Enforce identity/block/generation binding, duplicate handling, bounded per-peer and global storage, decode-work limits, expiry and abort. Release recovered data only after the approved whole-block authentication succeeds.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative microfrag.06 approval, not merely a closed decision. Keep the code isolated and default-off; do not rewrite baseline SCHC or OSCORE. Hardware/ports and on-air tests are excluded from this implementation unit.
acceptance_criteria: Independent microfrag.07 vectors and state traces cover mixed-block injection, oversized counts, corruption, exhausted memory/work budgets, timeout and restart. Fuzz the parser and state transitions. Report measured offline resource bounds and rejected cases without relaxing authentication to obtain success.
